subject_note: jarl-platform-followups wave 2026-07-31 — verifier [dedupwall-and-intake-reach]. Re-derivation recipes for the two inferred-not-read claims: (a) does Content.DedupWall run for type:task publishes, (b) does Plugins.Github.Intake retry or drop on {:error, {:dedup_unavailable, _}}.

recipes.subject: api/lib/barkpark/content/authoring_wall.ex
recipes.observed_value: @walled_types ~w(paper task) — dedup_gate/5 guards `when type in @walled_types`, so DedupWall.check/4 DOES run for type:task publishes

recipes.subject: api/lib/barkpark/content/dedup_wall.ex
recipes.observed_value: NO :timeout option anywhere; Repo.transaction(fn -> SET LOCAL trgm threshold; Repo.all(limit 500) end) inherits Ecto's 15_000ms default. rescue-only fail-open (Logger.warning + []), NO `catch :exit` — the exact pair Tasks.Dedup has at dedup.ex:256-264.

recipes.subject: api/lib/barkpark/tasks/dedup.ex
recipes.observed_value: @query_timeout_ms 5_000 (line 78); Repo.all(timeout: timeout) (line 255); rescue (256) AND catch :exit (261). The bounded twin.

recipes.subject: internal/cli/tasks_create_cmd.go
recipes.observed_value: bp task create sends a SECOND mutate {"publish":{"id":bareID,"type":"task"}} when publish is true (mcp_tasks.go:433 documents default true). So every default task create pays Tasks.Dedup (bounded) on create AND DedupWall (unbounded) on publish.

recipes.subject: api/lib/barkpark/plugins/github/intake.ex
recipes.observed_value: Clause order is {:duplicate_task,_} -> refused/2xx; {:halted,_} -> {:refused, doc_id}/2xx; {:dedup_unavailable, reason} -> returns {:error, {:dedup_unavailable, reason}}; {:error, reason} -> passthrough. The dedup_unavailable clause is BELOW the halted clause (a144d3c81's commit body says 'ABOVE'), which is harmless because the tags are disjoint, but the commit prose does not describe its own code.

recipes.subject: api/lib/barkpark_web/controllers/github_webhook_controller.ex
recipes.observed_value: handle_intake's {:error, reason} clause does NOT route through Content.Errors — it puts :internal_server_error with code "intake_failed". So on the WEBHOOK surface a dedup outage is a real 500. The 409/`halted` in errors.ex:443 is the API-mutate surface only.

recipes.subject: api/test/barkpark/plugins/github/
recipes.observed_value: Only 3 hits, ALL in api/test/barkpark/tasks/dedup_test.exs (168, 184, 197). ZERO hits under api/test/barkpark/plugins/github — the Intake clause a144d3c81 added is NOT pinned by any test at the Intake or controller level.

recipes.subject: git-grep BRE alternation
recipes.rerun: cd barkpark && git grep -c 'DedupWall\|authoring_wall' origin/main -- api/lib; echo exit=$?; git grep -c 'DedupWall' origin/main -- api/lib
recipes.observed_value: The alternation form exits 1 with NO output; the single-pattern form finds 3 files. `git grep 'A\|B'` is a SILENT FALSE NEGATIVE in this repo's git — use -E or repeated -e. The wave's own MUST-RUN grep mis-fired this way.
